content_gaps: Ranking pages are directories or product roundups; they list tools without saying which question each one answers.
None of the pages reviewed gives metric definitions such as the difference between fees and revenue.
Limits of on-chain data, such as exchange wallets holding many customers' balances, are barely covered.
No page reviewed gives a repeatable research workflow.
value_add: A question-first guide: which tool type answers which question, the published definitions behind the common metrics, and a holder-classification method that avoids misreading concentration.
